question: Should the complete canonical namespace be the existing singular `skill` or a new plural `skills`, and what alias and deprecation policy should preserve established root and singular invocations?
rationale: The consolidation is roadmap-aligned and technically bounded, but command spelling and removal timing are durable public CLI contract choices that cannot be inferred safely.

options.title: Expand singular `skill`
options.body: Make the established namespace cover the complete lifecycle and retain root aliases through a documented transition.

options.title: Introduce plural `skills`
options.body: Adopt the requested plural namespace and explicitly transition both the singular group and root commands.

options.title: Keep mixed hierarchy
options.body: Preserve all current invocation paths and treat visual help grouping as the permanent organization.

recommendation.title: Expand singular `skill`
recommendation.body: Make the established namespace cover the complete lifecycle and retain root aliases through a documented transition.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick proposed and milestoned the direction and owns the current command-registration implementation.
